title: Reagan-era release of Falcon and Condor in UFO Cover-Up Live

tellings.quote: the story was Reagan allowed the the whole thing about the Falcon and the Condor to come out and the alien at Wright Patterson Air Force Base.

plain: The story goes that President Ronald Reagan allowed claims to be made public on UFO Cover-Up Live, a 1988 American TV special, including the accounts of two insiders known only by the code names Falcon and Condor and talk of an alien kept at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio. A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron tells Michels this was "the story", without naming his source; if true, the broadcast was a quiet, sanctioned leak from the top.
